messages:
sara (AM): FYI incoming POC from Harpoon Health. They want Harpoon-70B-adapt in our catalog, KV prefix caching, and customer-managed KMS. Can we confirm compatibility + a quick cost ballpark?

mike_ml: Harpoon-70B-adapt is compatible but need to pick a quant variant. Out of the box we support fp16, 8q4, and 4q. 4q might save ~2-3x cost but could hurt hallucination on our tests.

anjali_se: What are their latency SLOs? If they want sub-200ms tail we might need dedicated capacity. Also kms flow: will they bring their own key or do they want us to manage envelope keys?

sara (AM): They asked for <=250ms 95th for chat workloads (avg prompt+gen ~1.5k tokens). They'll bring their own KMS (AWS). Want minimal changes to prompt engineering.

sam_platform: Suggested config for a trial (staging/dedicated):
```
model: harpoon-70b-8q4
replicas: 2
instance_type: p4d.24xlarge (or g5dn for perf/cost balance)
autoscale: min_replicas:2, max_replicas:6
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 6144
  max_latency_ms: 120
cache: prefix_kv_enabled: true
kms: customer_kms: aws:kms:arn:aws:kms:...
```
This should hit ~200-300ms p95 depending on infra and token churn. 8q4 is a good middle ground.

mike_ml: Quick perf tradeoffs: fp16 = best quality, highest cost. 8q4 = ~1.6x cost reduction vs fp16 with small quality delta on instruction tasks. 4q = biggest savings but need eval on their prompts. Recommend running our eval harness (link: https://redwood.internal/evals) against their prompt set.

anjali_se: Security checklist: since they're customer KMS + PHI-ish domain we need the SOC/ISO pack + KMS key policy review + a data flow diagram. Sam, can you open the infra ticket? I'll start the security questionnaire.

sam_platform: Opening infra ticket now: INF-12345 — allocate staging dedicated pool + attach KMS flow. Also uploading staging catalog variant: harpoon-70b-8q4 to staging.

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: catalog:harpoon-70b-8q4 added to staging (build 20250321.3)

sara (AM): Pricing ask from customer: small POC (~3 months) with up to 50k tokens/day. Can you give hosted vs dedicated delta and a committed discount structure? Need something to include in the SOW.

mike_ml: Hosted estimate: ~$0.012/token gen for fp16 (ballpark). For 8q4 expect ~0.0045/token gen. Dedicated: depends on commit. Rough: 1x p4d pool reserved month ~ $75k/mo capacity can cover their 50k tokens/day with headroom; effective unit price after commit ~ $0.0025/token. We should run exact calc with accounting. I'll attach a worksheet.

anjali_se: I'll add security blockers doc to the thread once questionnaire starts. We need an exec summary for Legal: data residency + KMS control + retention TTLs.

sam_platform: Note: if they need on-prem/private deploy we'll need additional lead time (~8-10 weeks) for packaging & validation. For now staging dedicated is fastest.

sara (AM): Great. Action items: Mike -> pricing worksheet + hosted vs committed calc; Sam -> INF-12345 for infra + KMS hookup; Anjali -> start security questionnaire & legal summary. I'll sync with the customer tomorrow and share their prompt set.

mike_ml: I'll post the pricing sheet by EOD.

anjali_se: Starting the questionnaire now, will ping if I need sample data.

sam_platform: INF-12345 updated: assigned to sam_platform, ETA for staging pool 3 business days.

sara (AM): Thanks all :thumbsup:
